test_name: Cinematic Viewer NRE spam in Rampage Arena - 8d5e77d8-3561-4f5a-a11a-2058ce6d8632
summary: Pass because this bug is already fixed on master: I set up the reported case on current master and the camera toolbox ran for about 650 frames with no errors. The error came from the camera toolbox trying to show its quick-capture marker on the singleplayer cockpit screen, which doesn't have that marker. A fix from Oct 5 already skips the missing marker, so the build in the screenshot was older than that fix. I didn't change any code, so this run opens no PR.
verified: Rampage Arena (Quick Rampage, singleplayer): the SP_PlayerMech mech OS has recording == null and recordingTimer == null at runtime, which is the input that made the pre-d72c4e45d2 code throw at CinematicViewer.cs:1423

Cinematic Viewer(Clone) spawned from Resources and opened (OnCinematicViewerChanged(true)), with quick mode on and then off, ran frames 1648-2297 with zero NullReferenceException and no CinematicViewer entries in the console
not_done: Multiplayer mech OS (MP Mech OS.prefab, recording assigned) not exercised at runtime: it needs a multiplayer session. I read that path in code: mechOS is typed MechOS, so its == null check catches a destroyed mech OS, and the marker and timer are null-guarded
Timed recording (_recordTimerActive) not exercised: it needs LCK recording, which this no-VR editor doesn't run. SetRecordingTimerSeconds and HideRecordingTimer both null-guard recordingTimer
